_comment: Player-facing server brief rendered by the homepage (frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx). The inputs live in eco-ops (configs/Configs/*.diff.json, mods/Mods, mods/Configs/SkillsRequirements.eco), but this page describes the world players join, so where the live server has drifted from eco-ops the live value wins (restarts). This file is a reviewed copy, so bump reviewedOn whenever it is re-checked. Cycle number, world size, meteor length, meteor state and the Eco version are deliberately absent: the homepage reads them from live status, and a second copy here is how the old Discord block went stale.

steps: Open Eco, choose Join, and search the server browser for Eco via Sirens.
Join the Discord for announcements, trade, and help from other players.
Read the welcome message the first time you log in.

nextCycle: Cycle 15 is being prepared on Eco 0.14 with a rebuilt mod list. The start date is announced in the Discord.

items.value: Off, play as long as you like

items.name: Easy Mining
items.summary: Mined rock goes straight into your pack instead of dropping rubble.

items.name: Easy Logging
items.summary: Felled trees hand you their debris and seeds, and stumps clear themselves.

items.name: Easy Digging
items.summary: Shovels carry more, 10, 20, 30, and 40 blocks from wooden to modern.

gameplayNotes.title: Dinner parties
gameplayNotes.body: Three parties a day count toward the bonus. Spread them across time zones so everyone gets a seat, and remember prepared food stays fresh for 600 minutes.

gameplayNotes.title: Every skill pays claims
gameplayNotes.body: Learning any skill grants 2 claim papers and 0.1 claim stakes, so land grows with what you know.

gameplayNotes.title: Specialize on purpose
gameplayNotes.body: Specialties cannot be abandoned and skills cost 3x, so plan your path with the skill trees and talk to the town before you commit.

gameplayNotes.title: Paid items
gameplayNotes.body: Paid items are sold in stores and work without a blueprint.

gameplayNotes.title: Build high, not deep
gameplayNotes.body: Terrain and buildings reach 200 blocks, but deep ocean building is off. Shallows and beaches are wide, so the coasts are the frontier.
